subject: APPLY-MANIFEST.md is on every session's path and grows without bound
recordedOccasion: from a session that measured the file while rebasing onto it three times, and from the owner having raised its read cost twice with nothing written down.
severity: moderate. The file is read by every revision to take a number and appended by every revision to record one, so its cost is paid by every session at once; and it is the file that conflicts in every rebase.
scope: the manifest itself and what reads it. The rules governing it are section 7 of `.github/session-management-instructions.md`, which is `entity-model-and-vocabulary-20260909-053548`'s.
read: `APPLY-MANIFEST.md` size, line and entry counts at Revision 298
its size at each of the last 30 commits that touched it, from the object store
the three rebases this session performed, and which files conflicted in each

members.statement: `APPLY-MANIFEST.md` is read and appended by every session and grows without bound, so its cost rises for everyone at once and no rule bounds it
members.sectionHeading: F1 — one file on every session's read path, growing without a bound

members.statement: The manifest is the file that conflicts in every rebase, because every session appends at the same place
members.sectionHeading: F2 — the conflict is structural, not incidental

contributions.contribution: Recorded both findings from measurements taken while rebasing onto the file three times

edges.why: one named file guarantees the collision 0038 describes in general, even between sessions that overlap nowhere else

indexNotes: Recorded 2026-09-10 by `drift-and-the-write-boundary-20260909-053548`, which does not own it. **Measurement only, no remedy proposed** — every plausible fix changes what §7 governs and §7 is another session's.
